facts.text: The wild double decker bus chase
facts.why: The chase is in Greyhound style coaches, not double deckers. Danko and Rostavili each commandeer a bus, and a freight train ends it.

facts.text: Pour the vodka when Danko orders his first drink in Chicago.
facts.why: Danko turns down a drink on arrival (asked if he is thirsty, he says no); the vodka moment is when a Chicago officer asks how Soviets deal with stress and he answers vodka.
facts.fix: Pour the vodka when Danko answers how Soviet cops handle stress.

vibe.verdict: Right pairing and a bit of Soviet flavour, but the cue and chase are off and the look is plain.
